name: token-leak-finder
description: Find out WHY your Claude Code / Codex limits run out. Local-only, reads logs already on disk.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/test/fixtures/generate.js && node dist/src/cli.js --claude-dir test/fixtures/data/claude --codex-dir test/fixtures/data/codex --home-dir test/fixtures/data/home --since 30d --redact --out reports/demo.html --json reports/demo.json --rules reports/suggested-rules.md
